notes: A polite, natural way to say a person is old, unlike '늙다' (to age/be old), which sounds blunt or rude when used directly about someone.
When speaking respectfully about an older person, use the honorific noun '연세' and the suffix '-(으)시-': '연세가 많으시다'.
